parts.name: Front Fork
parts.description: A 41 mm telescopic fork with 5.5 in of travel. Honda notes the stanchions are set 9.1 in apart. The standard model's fork tubes are exposed; only the SE adds black fork boots.
parts.function: Holds the front wheel, lets it move up and down over bumps and controls that motion with springs and oil damping. The fork also turns with the steering.

facts.label: Fork boots
facts.value: SE only (black fork boots) — not on the standard CMX500A

parts.name: Fork Tubes (Stanchions)
parts.description: The two chrome 41 mm inner tubes, clamped in the triple clamps.
parts.function: Slide in and out of the fork sliders as the suspension moves. Their smooth chrome surface is what the fork seals wipe against.
parts.verificationNote: The diameter and spacing are Honda-published. Part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Fork Sliders (Outer Tubes)
parts.description: The lower fork legs. They hold the front axle and carry the brake caliper mount.
parts.function: Move up and down with the wheel, sliding over the stanchions on bushings.

parts.name: Fork Springs
parts.description: Coil springs inside the fork legs.
parts.function: Support the bike's weight and absorb bump energy. Spring rate and preload set how high the front sits and how firm it feels.
parts.verificationNote: Spring rate, length and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Fork Bushings / Seals
parts.description: Low-friction bushings between the tubes and sliders, plus oil seals and dust seals.
parts.function: The bushings let the fork slide smoothly without play. The seals keep fork oil in and grit out.

parts.name: Fork Oil / Damping
parts.description: The fork oil and the internal damping parts.
parts.function: Forcing oil through small passages slows the fork's movement, so it doesn't keep bouncing on its springs.
parts.verificationNote: Oil type, oil level and damper design are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A. Consult Honda service manual 61MLH00.
